title: Set up team chat
summary: Create the team chat workspace, configure channels, set up integrations. Slack is the canonical route.

parts.title: Create the team chat workspace
parts.guidance: Check for an existing company chat workspace before creating another. Set the company name, workspace address, administrator, and account-recovery contact using company-controlled identities. Choose a plan that fits the agreed seat count and required features, with the budget owner's approval for paid commitments. Establish initial membership and visibility settings, then put the workspace link in the team's onboarding material.

parts.title: Create default channels
parts.guidance: Create a small channel set around the team's actual work: company announcements, active projects, operational questions, and any restricted discussions. Give each channel a short purpose and an owner for keeping it useful. Choose public or private visibility from the content and audience, then add a simple guide showing where a routine question, project update, or urgent issue belongs. Avoid empty channels created for hypothetical future teams.

parts.title: Invite team members
parts.guidance: Match the team roster to existing workspace members and prepare the remaining invitations with the correct company addresses and roles. Check guest and administrator access separately from ordinary membership. Have the workspace administrator confirm the invite list before sending, including any extra paid seats. Send newcomers the starting channels and onboarding link, and follow up on failed or unaccepted invitations with the person joining.

parts.title: Configure notification defaults
parts.guidance: Agree which channels or mentions need prompt attention and which can be read during normal work, taking time zones into account. Set shared defaults where the service supports them and explain the personal settings each teammate controls. Check a representative announcement or mention with a colleague to see whether it arrives as intended. Document whom to contact and how when an urgent issue needs attention.

metadata.supportReason: Slack API supports channel/user management. Workspace creation is manual. MCP integration available.
